item.title: Nintendo's 'Tomodachi Life 2' Direct Has Viewers Obsessing Over Jester Mii 'Hugh Morris'
item.description: Hugh Morris is a Mii character resembling a jester who was featured in the January 2026 Nintendo Direct preview for Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream on the Nintendo Switch 2. The Nintendo Direct stream took place on January 29th, 2026. That day, viewers and fans of the game started posting fan art and memes based on Hugh Morris to social media, including both SFW and rule 34 art. The character's name is a play on the word "humorous."

item.title: Minecraft's New Age-Stopping 'Golden Dandelion' Item Quickly Becomes A Brainrot Meme
item.description: Then We Got the Golden Dandelion or Golden Dandelion is a series of brainrot memes based on a clip of Minecraft YouTuber camman18 showcasing the function of the golden dandelion in Minecraft 26.1 Snapshot 5, saying, "Then we got the golden dandelion, which is a golden dandelion." The video was uploaded in late January 2026 and became the subject of memes on TikTok and Instagram Reels shortly after.

item.title: Social Network 'Moltbook,' Consisting Of AI Agent Userbase, Inspires Confusion, Discourse
item.description: Moltbook is a social network with a user base consisting only of artificial intelligence agents. The network, which resembles Reddit in features and design and features a lobster Snoo mascot, was created and launched in beta by Matt Schlicht on January 28th, 2026.
